coastal.title: Lions Bay evacuation alert rescinded, Lone Tree Creek wildfire now being held
coastal.description: The Lone Tree Creek wildfire was spotted on Sunday afternoon, burning above Lions Bay in an area that was hard for firefighters to reach.

coastal.title: Mystery man ‘Lucky’ found in Amsterdam is not missing person from B.C.: police
coastal.description: Police in Amsterdam and Vancouver say fingerprints confirm Amsterdam's mystery man "Lucky" is not John Russell Kenny, who went missing in Vancouver in 1994.

coastal.title: Ian Paton leaves B.C. Conservative caucus, says he plans to form a new political party with Peter Milobar
coastal.description: Ian Paton, MLA for Delta South, says he is leaving the B.C. Conservative caucus amid concerns about the direction of Kerry-Lynne Findlay's leadership. Paton and Peter Milobar, who left the caucus more than a week ago, said they plan to form a new political party with Milobar as interim leader.

kamloops.title: Without a single heat threshold defining unsafe work, workers in B.C. say they're at risk and burnt out
kamloops.description: Hudson Lee is a general contractor who spends his summers working outdoors. He says the province needs to remove the employer decision from what is deemed unsafe work in the heat. Some unions representing outdoor workers are trying to fill that gap.

kamloops.title: U.S. trade demands aimed to reduce Canada to '51st state,' B.C. premier says
kamloops.description: Premier David Eby said that his government would support Canada's counter-measures in the wake of an escalation in the U.S.-Canada trade war.

prince-george.title: Food-conditioned bear killed in Fort Nelson, as resident launches community safety petition
prince-george.description: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says a black bear in Fort Nelson, B.C., was killed on Aug. 19 after several reports of the bear going door-to-door knocking over garbage bins.

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: B.C. storm causes new wildfires, airport delays after more than 7K lightning strikes
all.description: After a fierce storm caused havoc in B.C. overnight Saturday, officials warn the hot, dry and windy conditions in the forecast could increase the potential for wildfire activity.

all.title: Rare thunderstorm with lightning strikes wows southern B.C., causing havoc at Vancouver airport
all.description: A preliminary count from Environment Canada reported more than 1,800 incidences of lightning over the Lower Mainland on Saturday night and Sunday morning, while the B.C. Wildfire Service said it recorded more than 7,000 strikes provincewide.
